name: Choline bitartrate
summary: Choline bitartrate is a nootropic substance belonging to the Ammonium salt chemical class.

uses.text: Choline bitartrate is used as a dietary supplement, a food additive, a nutrient and as a lipotropic compound. It is also used as a medication against bipolar disorder and mania (see: choline). Certain conducted double-blind, placebo-controlled studies of the effects of choline bitartrate treatment against Alzheimer-type dementias suggest improvement in some areas of patients' cognitive performance.

pharmacology.en: It supplies choline, which the body uses to make the nerve messenger acetylcholine and phosphatidylcholine, a key part of cell membranes. The tartrate part has no notable effect.
pharmacology.zh: 它提供膽鹼，身體會用膽鹼製造神經傳導物質乙醯膽鹼，以及細胞膜的重要成分磷脂醯膽鹼。酒石酸的部分則沒有明顯作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它提供胆碱，身体会用胆碱制造神经传导物质乙酰胆碱，以及细胞膜的重要成分磷脂酰胆碱。酒石酸的部分则没有明显作用。

sideEffects.en: Large amounts can cause a fishy body odour, stomach upset, diarrhoea, sweating and low blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 大量攝取可能造成身體散發魚腥味、腸胃不適、腹瀉、出汗與血壓降低。
sideEffects.zhHans: 大量摄取可能造成身体散发鱼腥味、肠胃不适、腹泻、出汗与血压降低。

fact.en: The bitartrate part comes from tartaric acid, found in grapes and wine. In 1848 Louis Pasteur discovered that molecules can have left and right-handed forms by sorting crystals of tartrate salts by hand.
fact.zh: 酒石酸氫鹽的部分來自酒石酸，存在於葡萄與葡萄酒中。1848 年，路易·巴斯德用手分揀酒石酸鹽的晶體，因而發現分子可以有左手與右手兩種形式。
fact.zhHans: 酒石酸氢盐的部分来自酒石酸，存在于葡萄与葡萄酒中。1848 年，路易·巴斯德用手分拣酒石酸盐的晶体，因而发现分子可以有左手与右手两种形式。
